selected.assay: bulk poly(A) RNA-seq, Illumina NovaSeq X Plus PE150, C2C12 myotubes (S4.10.p1)
selected.primary_estimand: Effect of 24 h electrical pulse stimulation (EPS, in vitro exercise-mimicking contraction; S2.1.p2, S4.9.p1) on gene expression in control C2C12 myotubes, and its dependence on Maff (EPS response in Maff KO myotubes; genotype x EPS interaction; S2.4.p1)
selected.sample_inclusion: All 12 GEO samples: Ctrl basal, Ctrl EPS, KO basal, KO EPS, n = 3 each (GEO characteristics). RNA harvested at day 7 of differentiation; EPS applied from day 6 for 24 h (S4.2.p2, S4.7.p1, S4.9.p1)
planned_contrasts: EPS vs basal in Ctrl myotubes (exercise effect; S2.4.p1 qRT-PCR only, no RNA-seq DEG count reported)
EPS vs basal in Maff KO myotubes (S2.4.p1 qRT-PCR only)
genotype x EPS interaction (attenuated EPS response in KO; S2.4.p1)
Maff KO vs Ctrl at day 7, basal (S2.3.p2: RNA-seq 588 down / 687 up DEGs, adjusted P < 0.001, n = 3/group, FIG6)
selected.repeated_measure_unit: none; independent culture wells, no pairing reported
selected.normalization: RaNA-seq framework, GRCm38; TPM deposited (S4.10.p1, GEO data_processing)
selected.paper_method: DESeq2 (S4.10.p1); paper does not state the design formula or which samples entered the KO vs Ctrl test

paper_results.KO_vs_Ctrl_RNAseq: 588 down, 687 up at adjusted P < 0.001; down includes muscle contraction/sarcomere genes; qRT-PCR down: Tnnc1, Xirp1, Xirp2, Myl1, Mybpc2, Nrap (S2.3.p2, FIG6)
paper_results.EPS_in_Ctrl_qPCR: EPS up in Ctrl: Myh2, Myh7, Abra, Acta1, Actc1, Atp2a2, Mettl21c; Maff and Mafa induced (FIG1 D); Myh1 and Egr1 unchanged (S2.4.p1)
paper_results.EPS_in_KO_qPCR: EPS responses not significant / blunted in KO; Myh4 reduced by EPS in KO only (S2.4.p1)

decisions.reason: The RNA-seq section (S4.10.p1) names GSE324257 and DESeq2. The only RNA-seq DEG count reported is KO vs Ctrl (S2.3.p2, adjusted P < 0.001, no fold-change rule). The exercise question in this paper is the in vitro EPS model (S2.1.p2 calls it an exercise-mimicking system), reported by qRT-PCR (S2.4.p1, FIG8). GEO deposits EPS and basal samples for both genotypes, so the EPS contrasts can be computed from the RNA-seq, but the paper gives no RNA-seq EPS DEG count to compare.

checks: paper S4.10.p1 and S7.p1 name GSE324257
C2C12 myotubes, Ctrl/Maff KO x basal/EPS, n=3 each matches paper design
matrix columns Ctrl_1..KO_E3 equal GEO library names in the description field

decisions.reason: Metadata and both supplementary TPM files belong to GSE324257, the accession the paper names (S4.10.p1, S7.p1). Library names match one-to-one.

Matrix columns are the GEO library names, held in the description field ('Library name: Ctrl_1,TPMs(Ctrl).xlsx'); the key is extracted from it and matched exactly. geno and stim come from the GEO genotype and treatment characteristics.

GEO data_processing states TPM values; every column sums to exactly 1,000,000; non-integer values (integer fraction 0.46 only because of zeros). The paper ran DESeq2 (S4.10.p1) on counts that were not deposited. TPM cannot go to DESeq2 and must not be rounded into counts.

selected.formula: ~ 0 + C(cell)  (cell = geno x stim, 4 cells of n=3)

decisions.reason: The exercise estimand is EPS vs basal in control myotubes (S2.4.p1); the paper's question is whether Maff KO changes it, so EPS in KO and the interaction are planned too. KO vs Ctrl basal is the paper's reported RNA-seq comparison (S2.3.p2; day-7 basal samples, n=3/group, assumed because the paper does not say whether EPS samples entered it). KO vs Ctrl under EPS is exploratory.

covariates.name: batch / culture replicate
covariates.disposition: excluded: not recorded in GEO or the paper

decisions.reason: Independent C2C12 wells; no subject, pairing, or batch is recorded in GEO or stated in the paper. Sample correlations on log2(TPM+1) show an unrecorded structure that crosses the EPS factor (Ctrl_1, Ctrl_E1, Ctrl_E3, KO_3, KO_E1, KO_E3 versus the other six); it is not documented, so it is reported as a caveat and not modelled.

selected.method: limma (moderated t, empirical Bayes) joint model on log2(TPM+1)
selected.low_expression_filter: TPM >= 1 in >= 3 samples (prep/merge_tpm.py), 13,779 of 34,866 genes kept

paper_route.reason: only TPM deposited in GEO (supplementary files and data_processing); DESeq2 needs integer counts

deviations: limma on log2(TPM+1) instead of DESeq2 on counts
low-expression filter TPM>=1 in >=3 samples instead of DESeq2 independent filtering

decisions.reason: Matrix policy: TPM -> log2(x+1) -> limma. The paper route (DESeq2) is blocked because counts were not deposited; this runs as a declared deviation.

selected.deviation_note: paper rule (adjusted P < 0.001, S2.3.p2) applied to limma BH-adjusted p; it is the paper's only RNA-seq DE rule and is applied to the EPS contrasts too. Audit: BH padj < 0.05 (workflow default).

decisions.reason: S2.3.p2: DEGs at adjusted P < 0.001, no fold-change rule. Applied unchanged on the limma route.

One limma model ~ 0 + C(cell) on all 12 samples; planned contrasts (EPS in Ctrl primary, EPS in KO, interaction, KO vs Ctrl basal) plus the remaining analyzable comparison (KO vs Ctrl under EPS) as exploratory.
